newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end higher on farm tax news.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end higher on farm tax news.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended higher on Monday on speculative buying of a handful of blue chips on news that the government plans to tax agricultural income to help plug its yawning budget deficit, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 9.16 points, or 0.67 percent, to end at 1,383.79. Losers led gainers 154 to 86.

"People have welcomed the news of the imposition of farm tax. But it is too early to say whether these gains could be sustained or not until government comes out with a final package after talks with the IMF," one dealer said.
